description:
Confirms the configured API key works, lists the organizations it can reach, and reports whether writing is enabled. Read-only and safe to call first when diagnosing setup.

🔴 Call this before concluding that this server cannot modify anything. Every tool is registered whether or not its gate is open, so a tool being listed says nothing about whether it will run. `writesEnabled` and `runsEnabled` are the authority — GHOST_INSPECTOR_ALLOW_WRITES and GHOST_INSPECTOR_ALLOW_RUNS. When one is false the operator must set the matching variable and restart this server; it cannot be turned on from a tool call.

Returns each organization's id — export the one you want as GHOST_INSPECTOR_ORG_ID to enable on-demand validation runs.
name: gi_whoami
title: Ghost Inspector: verify credentials and check what this server may do
